Question: If an advertisement shows the interior of a train with comfortable seats and plenty of space yet a customer boards a train only to find a lack of space and hard seating. This is an example of:

Options: 
A. GAP 9-the gap between service delivery and customer satisfaction.
B. GAP 2-the gap between management perception and service-quality specification
C. GAP 4-the gap between service delivery and external communications.
D. GAP 5-the gap between customer perception and customer expectation.
E. GAP 7-the gap between service quality and customer perception.
F. GAP 3-the gap between service-quality specifications and service delivery.
G. GAP 10-the gap between service quality and service delivery.
H. GAP1-the gap between the customer's expectations and management perception.
I. GAP 6-the gap between customer expectation and management perception.
J. GAP 8-the gap between external communications and customer expectation.

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
